nodes.description: OpenOracleData.source(message, signature): recovers signer address via ecrecover of a keccak256 hashed message
OpenOraclePriceData.put(message, signature): external entry point that decodes and stores reporter prices
putInternal(source, timestamp, key, value): writes Datum to storage when newer than stored and within block.timestamp + 60 minutes
decodeMessage(message, signature): recovers source and abi.decodes the oracle payload, requiring kind == prices
get(source, key): returns (timestamp, value) of the stored Datum
getPrice(source, key): returns only the stored value of the Datum
UniswapConfig constructor: validates configs length and materializes 30 immutable token config slots
get(configs, i): returns config at index i or a zeroed TokenConfig when out of range
getCTokenIndex(cToken): linear search over immutable cToken slots, returns uint(-1) when not found
getUnderlyingIndex(underlying): linear search over immutable underlying slots
getSymbolHashIndex(symbolHash): linear search over immutable symbolHash slots
getTokenConfig(i): public view returning the i-th TokenConfig, bounded by numTokens
getTokenConfigBySymbol(symbol): hashes the symbol string and looks the config up
getTokenConfigBySymbolHash(symbolHash): resolves an index by symbol hash or reverts
getTokenConfigByCToken(cToken): resolves by cToken and falls back to an external CErc20.underlying() call
getTokenConfigByUnderlying(underlying): resolves an underlying address to a config
FixedPoint.fraction(numerator, denominator): builds a uq112x112 ratio, reverting on a zero denominator
FixedPoint.decode112with18(self): decodes uq112x112 into an 18 decimal uint
currentBlockTimestamp(): returns block.timestamp truncated to uint32
currentCumulativePrices(pair): reads uniswap pair reserves and counterfactually accumulates prices
UniswapAnchoredView constructor: sets oracle, reporter, tolerance bounds and seeds uniswap observations
price(symbol): external view returning the stored price for a symbol
priceInternal(config): selects reporter, fixed USD or fixed ETH derived price
getUnderlyingPrice(cToken): Compound PriceOracle entry point with baseUnit scaling
postPrices(messages, signatures, symbols): stores oracle messages then refreshes anchored prices
postPriceInternal(symbol, ethPrice): compares reporter price to anchor and stores or guards it
isWithinAnchor(reporterPrice, anchorPrice): tolerance band check between reporter and anchor
currentCumulativePrice(config): reads the token/ETH accumulator for a config, honoring isUniswapReversed
fetchEthPrice(): fetches the ETH/USD anchor price with ethBaseUnit conversion
fetchAnchorPrice(symbol, config, conversionFactor): computes a uniswap TWAP anchor price
pokeWindowValues(config): rotates new/old uniswap observations when the anchor period elapsed
invalidateReporter(message, signature): reporter-signed circuit breaker activation
UniswapAnchoredView.source(message, signature): signature recovery used by invalidateReporter
